AlienRace.BackstoryDef.title: Chief terraformist
AlienRace.BackstoryDef.baseDescription: {PAWN_nameDef} the Chief terraformist on board of the colony ship, Covetheus. {PAWN_nameDef} is in charge of an entire wing of the ship dedicated to greenhouses, farming equipment, and machinery necessary to transform a planet into a home.

AlienRace.BackstoryDef.title: Chief Pilot
AlienRace.BackstoryDef.baseDescription: {PAWN_nameDef} the Chief Pilot on board of the colony ship, Covetheus. {PAWN_nameDef} is in charge of the ship operations, navigations and responsible for the safety of the ship.

AlienRace.BackstoryDef.title: Bridge Officer
AlienRace.BackstoryDef.baseDescription: {PAWN_nameDef} the Bridge Officer on board of the colony ship, Covetheus. {PAWN_nameDef} is in charge of navigation and safety of the ship, unless relieved by the Chief Pilot or a higher ranking officer.

AlienRace.BackstoryDef.title: Chief Science Officer
AlienRace.BackstoryDef.baseDescription: {PAWN_nameDef} the Science Officer on board of the colony ship, Covetheus. {PAWN_nameDef} is in charge of researching new technologies and starting a full ecology workup to unknown planets.

AlienRace.BackstoryDef.title: Military Security
AlienRace.BackstoryDef.baseDescription: {PAWN_nameDef} the Military Security on board of the colony ship, Covetheus. {PAWN_nameDef} is tasked with keeping the scientists and other colonists safe.
